claim: Amazon's first fiscal quarter of 2024 filing showed $531.0B in total assets, plus $143.3B in revenue.
summary: Revenue of ~$143.3B for Q1 2024 is established in memory, but the exact $531.0B total-assets figure cannot be confirmed without the filing, so the full claim cannot be supported.

sub_claims.text: Amazon's Q1 2024 filing reported $531.0B in total assets.
sub_claims.note: I recall total assets around $531B for March 31, 2024, but cannot reliably confirm the exact one-decimal $531.0B figure from memory alone without the 10-Q, so not established.

sub_claims.text: Amazon's Q1 2024 filing reported $143.3B in revenue.
sub_claims.note: Q1 2024 net sales of about $143.3B is well-established in my knowledge of Amazon's Q1 2024 results.
